$comment: Which matches get a won-match reel (W01..: every own kill of the match plus the result screen, V canvas; pieces in data/clip/montage.json). User decision D315 (2026-11-09), replacing the VICTORY-only selection of D237. A match gets a reel when any rule passes. Every condition of a rule must hold. A condition whose signal was not read leaves the rule inert: an inert rule never gives a reel (no guessing). Signals come from services/clip/match_gate.py segment(): result = W1 (a signalled VICTORY/DEFEAT box), place = the own card on the S1 top-3 screen, mode = the S1 mode_label read on the top-3 screen (lower case), kills = own kills (scoreboard if read, else the deduplicated own kill-feed lines). Per-round kills are not detected by any detector yet. Thresholds are the user's words; detector status is in detectors.json.
user: for won if top3 go ahead. if defeat if it's top go ahead. if won or defeat if the kills are more than 20 (in hardpoint, domination, control) - go ahead, if it's TDM kills above 7 go ahead, in search if it a win or muliple kills within a round go ahead.

rules.label: defeated and placed top 2
rules.note: User D315a (2026-11-09): 'if it's top' means top 2 (defeat max place 2). No DEFEAT top-3 screen has been seen yet, so which team's top 3 it shows is unverified (detector, not rule).

rules.label: more than 20 own kills in Hardpoint, Domination or Control
rules.note: User D315, won or defeated. Only 'hardpoint' has been read on a top-3 screen; 'control' is not in the S1 modeNames (no frame), so a Control match reads no mode and this rule stays inert for it.

rules.label: more than 7 own kills in Team Deathmatch
rules.note: User D315: 'if it's TDM kills above 7'. Won or defeated. No TDM top-3 screen read yet.

rules.label: won a Search and Destroy match
rules.note: User D315: 'in search if it a win'. No Search and Destroy end screen read yet.

rules.label: at least 2 own kills within one Search and Destroy round
rules.note: User D315: 'muliple kills within a round' (multiple = at least 2). Inert until round boundaries are detected: needs labelled Search and Destroy footage with round start/end screens.
